lcc_original: 永恆主上帝用地上的塵土塑造了野地各樣走獸、和空中各樣飛鳥，帶到那人面前，看他給叫甚麼；那人怎樣叫各樣有生命的活物，那就是那活物的名字。
notes: LCC 永恆主 renders UNV 耶和華 (WH03068); LCC 上帝 renders UNV 神 (WH0430) — standard Lü systematic substitutions.
LCC expands UNV 土 (WH0127) to 地上的塵土 ('dust of the ground'); WH0127 attached to the full noun phrase since it is a single Hebrew lexeme (אֲדָמָה).

LCC 給 (before 叫 in first clause) is treated as an explicit rendering of the implicit {<WAH09001>} (לוֹ = 'to it/him'); braces dropped per Rule 3, giving 給<WAH09001>叫<WH07121><WTH8799>. This is the main uncertainty: 給 could alternatively be a Chinese valency/aspect particle with no direct Hebrew equivalent.
LCC 有生命的活物 expands UNV 活<WH02416>物<WH05315> (נֶפֶשׁ חַיָּה). Both SNs are attached to the phrase end per Rule 6.
Second {<WAH09001>} (לוֹ in the second relative clause) remains implicit — LCC has no explicit word for it there, unlike the first clause.
LCC 那活物的名字 renders UNV 牠的名字; WH08034 (שְׁמוֹ = 'his name') attached to 名字 as the head noun.
